title: From bowls to pots: The dairying revolution in Northwest Turkey, a view from Barcın Höyük, 6600 to 6000 BCE

passages.quote: Barcın Höyük has shown that the production, transformation, and consumption of dairy products was already prevalent in Northwest Anatolia by 6600 cal. BCE, at the end of the first half of the seventh millennium cal. BCE (Early Period)

Overall, the four-lugged pot that emerged as a specialized dairy vessel type around 6200 cal BCE at Barcın Höyük may have become the typical dairy processing vessel during the Early Chalcolithic in the Marmara Region.
